segments.t: Back at the agency, Andrea Martel takes the reins as general director following Mathias Barneville's departure. Determined to prove that ASK remains strong despite industry rumors, she rallies Gabriel and Arlette around an aggressive new strategy focused on television series and emerging talent. Yet behind her confident front, Andrea struggles with her blunder over Charlotte Gainsbourg's dreadful screenplay. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
